title: Integral K5 injectivity for regular local domains
exact_target: For every Noetherian regular local domain A with fraction field F, is the canonical map on integral algebraic K-groups $K_{5}(A)\to K_{5}(F)$ injective, including ramified mixed characteristic?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: An integral counterexample to Gersten's conjecture
